verdict: Render matches the original parallelogram ABCD: all four sides meet at the correct vertices, labels are bound to the right corners and sit clear of strokes. The only discrepancy is heavier stroke weight.

issues.description: All four solid sides are drawn noticeably heavier than in the original (render strokes look roughly 1.5 to 2 times the original width relative to figure size). Overall the render looks bolder.
issues.suggestion: Reduce the global line width, e.g. change \begin{tikzpicture}[line width=2.2pt, ...] to about line width=1.2pt or 1.4pt, and re-check against the original stroke weight.

The original top stroke runs continuously from the A corner to the D corner, so it joins A and D.
